test_title: SSC CGL 2021 Tier-I (Held On : 21 April 2022 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
Select the option that expresses the given sentence in passive voice.

She baked a large blueberry cake.

options.text: A large blueberry cake was being baked by her.
A large blueberry cake was baked by her.
A large blueberry cake has been baked by her.
A large blueberry cake is baked by her.

solution:
The correct answer is '**A large blueberry cake was baked by her.'**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The given sentence is in **active voice.** As per the question we have to change it into** passive voice.**
 
• The structure of the given sentence is as
